policy_direction_of_yea: Levy an additional Cherokee County sales tax dedicated exclusively to public schools.
position_summary: Sponsored a local sales-tax increase earmarked for public education.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. The policy combines a regressive tax instrument with progressive public-school investment.

policy_direction_of_yea: Authorize Public School and College Authority bonds and negotiated sales for education capital, swap obligations, and school-bus fleet renewal, backed by pledged Public School Fund revenue.
position_summary: Co-sponsored bond financing for public-education capital needs and school-bus replacement.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This is active public-school investment, with debt and swap-financing risks that should remain visible in fiscal analysis.

policy_direction_of_yea: Appropriate Public School Fund money to local boards of education for fiscal-year 2011 operating expenses and authorize its expenditure.
position_summary: Co-sponsored state operating support for local public-school systems.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This is direct public-education funding evidence.

policy_direction_of_yea: Allow officers and employees of the Alabama Higher Education Partnership to participate in the Teachers' Retirement System.
position_summary: Co-sponsored extending public retirement-system eligibility to employees of a higher-education advocacy organization.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. The bill expands retirement access, though to a narrow quasi-public/nonprofit group rather than general educators.

policy_direction_of_yea: Allow both the Teachers' and Employees' Retirement Systems to amortize accrued pension liabilities over as many as 30 years rather than 20.
position_summary: Co-sponsored lengthening the public pension liability funding period to reduce near-term contribution pressure.
review_note: Official synopsis and the parallel teachers-only bill text reviewed. Longer amortization eases current budgets but delays funding and can raise long-run costs.

policy_direction_of_yea: Allow qualifying School Superintendents of Alabama executives and employees to continue participating in the Teachers' Retirement System.
position_summary: Co-sponsored preserving Teachers' Retirement System participation for employees of the superintendents' association.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This is a narrow benefit-continuation measure.

policy_direction_of_yea: Mourn the death of Archie L. Farmer.
position_summary: Sponsored a constituent memorial resolution.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This is ceremonial.

policy_direction_of_yea: Commend the Alabama Future Farmers of America.
position_summary: Sponsored a ceremonial commendation of a student agriculture organization.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. Recognition alone is not agricultural policy evidence.

policy_direction_of_yea: Move pesticide and pesticide-device registration to a biennial cycle and adopt a new fee schedule.
position_summary: Sponsored revised pesticide registration timing and fees.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. The change affects agricultural regulatory cost and administration, but the compact record does not establish whether total burden rises or falls enough for a directional code.

policy_direction_of_yea: Authorize the Revenue Commissioner to require taxpayers in a unitary business to supply additional information in an alternative reporting format.
position_summary: Sponsored expanded information authority for auditing complex multistate or unitary-business income taxes.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. The measure strengthens tax administration and anti-avoidance capacity without itself changing rates.

policy_direction_of_yea: Distribute Cherokee County's share of TVA in-lieu-of-tax payments under the revised 2010 allocation law.
position_summary: Sponsored a local distribution formula for TVA replacement-tax revenue.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This is distributive local fiscal policy with no general tax-rate direction.

policy_direction_of_yea: Require a court considering a stay of child-custody or visitation proceedings during a related criminal case to evaluate the child's best interest.
position_summary: Co-sponsored a child-welfare safeguard when criminal charges intersect with custody litigation.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. The policy adds judicial discretion centered on child welfare rather than consistently favoring either accused parents or opposing parties.

policy_direction_of_yea: Rename Shoal Creek Bridge the Disabled American Veterans Memorial Bridge.
position_summary: Co-sponsored an honorary bridge designation.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This is ceremonial.

policy_direction_of_yea: Name a Lauderdale County highway segment for Major David Blair Faulkner.
position_summary: Co-sponsored an honorary memorial highway designation.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This is ceremonial.

policy_direction_of_yea: Name a Highway 20 segment for golfer Stewart Cink.
position_summary: Co-sponsored an honorary highway designation.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This is ceremonial.

policy_direction_of_yea: Continue producer-assessment programs for specified agricultural commodities after referendums while moving association audits to every two years and requiring financial statements.
position_summary: Co-sponsored farmer-approved commodity promotion assessments with revised financial oversight.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. The program is collective agricultural market development funded by assessments, while reduced audit frequency is deregulatory; code mixed.

policy_direction_of_yea: Constitutionally prohibit counties and municipalities from levying occupational taxes.
position_summary: Co-sponsored a statewide constitutional ban on local occupational taxes.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This is direct anti-tax and local-revenue restriction evidence.

policy_direction_of_yea: Reorganize Alabama criminal-justice information governance, authorize licensing background checks and interstate history exchange, create a statistical center, and establish fees and penalties for misuse.
position_summary: Sponsored expanded and modernized criminal-history data, background-check, analysis, and misuse-enforcement systems.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. The bill increases public-safety information capacity and background screening while adding data-governance safeguards; code mixed.

policy_direction_of_yea: Create the crime of criminally negligent firearm storage and impose penalties.
position_summary: Sponsored a safe-storage offense for negligently secured firearms.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This is direct gun-safety regulation and progressive firearms evidence.

policy_direction_of_yea: Allow public college and university boards of trustees to meet by telephone or video conference under specified conditions.
position_summary: Sponsored remote participation in higher-education board meetings.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. Without evidence that notice, quorum, or public-access rules change materially, this is administrative rather than ideological.

policy_direction_of_yea: Allow teachers and school officials to satisfy child-abuse reporting duties through a written report to a principal or superintendent by the next school day, with the administrator then forwarding it to authorities.
position_summary: Sponsored an internal written-report safe harbor and administrator forwarding duty for suspected child abuse.
review_note: Official synopsis and identical House-bill text reviewed. Documentation and responsibility are clarified, but immediate direct reporting is delayed and redirected; code mixed.

policy_direction_of_yea: Authorize distinctive plates for out-of-state colleges and universities and direct proceeds to the Education Trust Fund for high-school dropout prevention.
position_summary: Sponsored an optional fee mechanism funding dropout-prevention efforts.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. The program expands public education funding through voluntary specialty-plate purchases.

policy_direction_of_yea: Clarify profit and nonprofit status in private-school definitions and change the baseline date governing statutory exemptions.
position_summary: Sponsored revision of private-school regulatory definitions and exemptions.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. The change is substantively within private-school regulation, but the compact description does not establish which schools gain or lose exemption; retain low-confidence mixed evidence rather than guessing direction.

policy_direction_of_yea: Create a Mobile-specific procedure to quiet title to tax-sale properties acquired from the State Land Commissioner instead of using the general Title 40 process.
position_summary: Sponsored a streamlined local title-clearing process for tax-sale property.
review_note: Official synopsis reviewed. This may facilitate reuse of distressed property but alters procedural protections; no stable left-right direction is supported.
